chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about buying gold with its earth/dirt from the mine. He said, 'There is no harm in it.'

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: There is no harm in it (permissible)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy gold directly from the mine including the soil?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) permits purchasing raw gold directly from the mine, including the accompanying soil or impurities. This ruling highlights the flexibility in commercial transactions (*mu'amalat*) regarding the inclusion of natural byproducts, distinguishing it from strict *riba* (usury) concerns that often apply to weighed gold. It underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that unless a specific prohibition exists, trade involving raw materials from their source is valid.
